question: 薄音能否通过动态压缩与并行混合获得可听、自然的密度改善（不做广度随机扫描）

compressor.detector: dual-branch one-pole RMS on mean-square: attack branch tau=15ms, release branch tau=120ms, per-sample max (classic RMS ballistics envelope); level=10*log10(envelope)
compressor.curve: soft knee width 6.0dB centered at threshold (quadratic), above: GR=0.75*(L-T)
compressor.time_constant_convention: 63% step response in the power (mean-square) domain; no extra detector window; no lookahead
compressor.gr_definition: frame-mean smoothed GR over active 40ms frames; target=P90
compressor.active_definition: 40ms frame RMS within 35.0dB of max frame
compressor.mix: out = (1-wet)*dry + wet*compressed_branch, branch loudness-matched to dry by constant makeup gain before mixing

gr_target_definition: P90 of frame-mean gain reduction over active 40ms frames; threshold auto-calibrated per target (max 6 iterations, tol 0.2dB)
p4_purpose: 观察强压缩边界，不预设更好听；若触发持续过压缩标记仍保留供诊断

references.A_AES2022_attack_release_audibility: https://aes.org/publications/elibrary/elibrary-page/?id=21958 — 不把精力放在细小 Attack/Release 扫描
references.B_MDPI2020_aggressive_descriptor: https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/10/7/2350 — 强压缩可能带来攻击性/粗糙感，故设 8dB 上界与诊断标记
references.C_JAES2014_perceptual_compression: https://aes.org/publications/elibrary/elibrary-page/?id=17084 — 压缩未必改善主观音质，全部响度匹配后盲听
references.D_SMM2019_glottal_source: https://www.isca-archive.org/smm_2019/cabral19_smm.html — 若压缩失效，后续转向声源/发声特性诊断而非继续调参
references.disclaimer: 以上参数为工程实验设计，并非上述论文验证过的最佳组合
